card.name: Start of compound place names
card.fires_on: The first part of a compound word or place name, mostly "High" in High Rochester, Highgate or Highland, where the rest of the word follows. It also fires on similar openers such as Fire, Long, Castle and Town.

modes.label: High in place names
modes.description: The word High opening a British place name or word like Highgate, Highland or High Rochester.

modes.label: Other compound openers
modes.description: Short words such as Fire, Long, Castle or Town that begin a compound or a named institution.
